kind: CAF ADM3 SIGCAF and 2003 census primary-method follow-through

sources.title: La RCA en Chiffres; government census results, Bangui 30 June 2005
actual_read: Printed introduction page2 and technical note page3/PDF4
findings: Government technical note dates census cartography to 1999 and reports 3,426 enumeration areas. Pilot March2002; enumeration 8–22December2003; postenumeration survey March2004 concerns coverage/count adjustment.

Annex depicts regional/prefectural divisions, including Mbomou and Haut-Mbomou, with 0–500km scale and regional colours. No ADM3 municipality boundaries, channel-control specification or coordinate grid appears.
sources.limits: Enumeration preparation and population coverage are not tests of international-boundary positioning; this booklet does not bind its maps to the 175 consumed ADM3 polygons.

sources.title: ICASEES RGPH3 2003 catalog40, DDI-IHSN-RGPH3-2003
sources.actual_read: Public catalog and linked JSON metadata
findings: Catalog identifies BCR/government census and UNFPA assistance, preparation 1995–1997 and enumeration in December2003.
Inspected links/JSON expose metadata, not a spatial-control manual or exact polygon inventory.
sources.limits: Some metadata mixes sampling/MICS material and conflicts on decree year; do not use those fields for census spatial control. Catalog requires authorization for underlying data; no request or access attempted.

sources.title: Mapping Conflict Motives: Central African Republic, IPIS,17February2009
findings: Producer says SIGCAF1996 systematically GPS-recorded village locations. Other inputs were HDPT CAR, University of Bangui LACCEG, IGN1:200000 maps1955–1984 and IGN tourist map1980.
IPIS basic map uses several sources for boundaries and other features; its own incomplete village-location handling is described.
sources.limits: Primary account of IPIS source use, not the original SIGCAF survey manual. GPS village points do not prove surveyed municipality edges; IPIS placement limits are not automatically errors in the consumed CAF polygons.

sources.outcome: 403 Forbidden; stopped, no retry, no body inspected

inference: The archive screenshot’s 1996/2003/1:200000 lineage is consistent with multiple stages, not one authenticated boundary survey.1999 enumeration cartography is separately documented.

No recovered method record supplies municipality-edge observation, original coordinates, channel convention, positional control or exact175-feature lineage. Neither census success nor point GPS work substitutes for these.
For Ango, five ADM3 operands now have explicit empty native kinds; their source history is preserved without using it to clear active CAF1/2 conflicts. Bondo application belongs to coordinator.
finite_limit: Named public census catalog, linked metadata, actual government booklet and producer source inventory read. No original detailed SIGCAF technical manual recovered. GEF lead denied; no universal absence claimed.
